summary.content:
Today's selection covers 49 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 30 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic sues US government for calling it a risk
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: FBI warns of phishing attacks impersonating US city, county officials
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 17 articles published in the last 24 hours
